component.name: KiraOtoToolbox
component.summary: Batch processing toolbox for UTAU oto.ini voicebank files

description.p: KiraOtoToolbox is a desktop application for manipulating oto.ini files — the voicebank labeling format used by UTAU, a singing voice synthesis engine. It provides 18+ tools for batch processing audio voicebank data, with both GUI and JavaScript scripting support.

ul.li: Batch edit oto.ini entries with 18+ specialized tools
Add, remove, and modify affixes and aliases
Merge, split, and deduplicate voicebank data
Batch adjust overlap, preutterance, and tempo
Built-in preset system for repeatable workflows
Chain tool for composing sequential operations
